reserveReview.rationale: Retrieved 2026-10-29: the October 27 Schedule of Assets publishes fifteen asset rows totaling $298,305,266.97 and separately labelled AUM of $287,977,821.61. The fifteen amounts sum exactly in cents to the declared gross asset total; all reviewed slices were refreshed together against that denominator, combining the two Treasury rows ($161,379,341.65 and $6,151,628.12). The $10,327,445.36 gross-assets/AUM difference is retained, not normalized away, and AUM is not circulating token liabilities. No whole-token collateralization ratio, independent assurance or funded redemption capacity is inferred. Three USDG lending rows are now itemized separately (Kamino lending $3,785,578.54, Kamino fixed-rate lending $9,994,415.00, Loopscale lending $1,526,716.15) alongside USDG spot of $67,705,537.87. USDv contributes $1,003,680.21; its replacement-mint identity retains the September 30 finalized-slot-451897337 proof, not a new on-chain read. The dated schedule supplies categories but no Treasury maturity roster or binding maximum tenor. The August 31 Apex AUP was recovered in the public rendered viewer on October 20 and compares management-provided NAV/support, expressly without an assurance conclusion or direct third-party corroboration; it does not examine the October 27 holdings. Custody, posted reinsurance collateral and insurance obligations remain separately scoped; underlying USDG/USDv reserve gaps are not closed by this local category refresh.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: OnRe Schedule of Assets dated 2026-10-27; all fifteen published asset amounts divided by the exactly reconciled $298,305,266.97 gross asset total; Treasury rows combined; USDG lending venues itemized; original September 30 replacement-USDv identity proof retained

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The ONyc Pool operates inside a Bermuda segregated account whose assets and liabilities are legally ring-fenced from OnRe's other books, and On Re SAC Ltd holds BMA Class IIGB insurer and Class F DABA licences (registration 55347; registry match confirmed by the 2026-07-15 Pharos registry pass), which grounds segregated custody and a structured bankruptcy-remoteness posture. Not known: the off-chain banks, brokers, or reinsurance trust accounts holding posted collateral; per-account segregation at those institutions; and the recovery waterfall if a reinsurance counterparty or cedent defaults. The 2026-07-20 review classified posting pool capital to reinsurance counterparties as conditional rehypothecation. Under D10, that investment and collateral-posting exposure remains distinct from a custodian's legal right to reuse pledged assets. OnRe's portfolio prose says capital is never leveraged or reused, but investor capital is governed by Participation Agreements and the platform terms give other agreements priority. Those governing reuse terms were not publicly recovered in this review; neither legal permission nor prohibition is established. Reinsurance exposure and redemption-liquidity risk remain independently applicable.
